root_cause.text: The `xhci_portli_show` function in the xhci debugfs driver dereferences the `port->rhub` pointer without validating it is non-NULL, causing a crash when processing ports that are not associated with a roothub due to hardware capability reporting gaps.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds an explicit `if (!port->rhub)` check before accessing `port->rhub->hcd`, addressing the CVE description which states that "In such cases port->rhub will be NULL so we can't reach xhci behind it" when `max_ports` exceeds reported ports or gaps exist in 'Supported Protocol' capabilities.
